saccharine.title: X3 Q2 twin rolling sphere numbers
saccharine.tip: Spring energy pays for KE (7/10 Mv^2) and the climb (d + x) sin theta.
saccharine.key:
$\tfrac12kx^2=1.80$ J; $\tfrac{7}{10}Mv^2=0.806$ J.
$Mg\sin\theta\,(d+x)=0.994$ J, so $d+x=0.300$ m.
Subtract $x=0.120$ m.
Answer: 0.180 m

saccharine.title: X3 Q8 hydraulic lift second student, practice
saccharine.tip: Doubling the student weight adds one elephant-pressure Mg/A. Fluid height supplies it: rho g h.
saccharine.key:
Extra pressure $=Mg/A_e$ (the student pressure doubled).
$\rho g h=Mg/A_e$, so $h=M/(\rho\pi r^2)$.
$h=1200/(900\pi)=0.424$ m.
Answer: 42.4 cm

body.md: Four point masses sit at the corners of a rectangle whose horizontal edge is $2a$ and vertical edge is $2b$, $a=4.60\ \text{m}$, $b=2.90\ \text{m}$, joined by rigid massless rods: $2.20\ \text{kg}$ top-left, $1.70\ \text{kg}$ top-right, $3.90\ \text{kg}$ bottom-left and $2.80\ \text{kg}$ bottom-right. The rotation axis is the LEFT edge (the vertical edge through the two left-hand masses). Find the torque (in kN·m) that speeds its rotation about that axis up by an additional $52.0\ \text{rpm}$ each second.

problems.title: X3 Q8 twist hydraulic lift pistons at different heights

body.md: A hydraulic lift holds oil of density $880\ \text{kg/m}^3$. A $1340\ \text{kg}$ elephant stands on the big piston (diameter $2.20\ \text{m}$); the small piston has diameter $48.0\ \text{cm}$. In equilibrium the elephant's piston sits $15.0\ \text{cm}$ HIGHER than the small piston. Find the mass (in kg) of the student standing on the small piston.

problems.title: X3 Q2 twist twin hollow sphere numbers

body.md: A $0.650\ \text{kg}$ thin hollow sphere ($I=\tfrac23MR^2$) is pressed against a spring ($k=310\ \text{N/m}$) compressed $11.5\ \text{cm}$ along a $22.0^\circ$ incline. Released from rest, it rolls without slipping up the incline. How far past the spring's relaxed end (in m) has it traveled when its speed is $1.35\ \text{m/s}$?

body.alt: A hollow round body rolls up an incline away from a relaxed spring that lies along the incline at the bottom; d runs along the ramp from the spring's relaxed end to the body, and its velocity v points up the slope.

problems.how: Number only, in m, 3 significant figures. No unit typed.

saccharine.title: X3 Q2 twist twin hollow sphere numbers
saccharine.tip: Spring energy pays for KE (translation + spin) and the climb (d + x) sin theta.
saccharine.key:
$\tfrac12kx^2=2.050$ J; $\tfrac56Mv^2=0.987$ J.
$Mg\sin\theta\,(d+x)=1.063$ J.
Solve for $d+x$, subtract $x$.
Answer: 0.330 m
